Forwood’s Safety+ is a fully integrated safety ecosystem meticulously designed to meet your organisation's unique safety requirements. Incorporating a range of vital tools built on Forwood's market-leading Critical Risk Management methodology, Safety+ empowers your organisation to achieve a streamlined, data-driven approach to fatality prevention, continuous improvement and overall safety excellence.



Forwood Safety+ is the native, dedicated mobile app for Safety+. An out of the box safety management system, Forwood Safety+ can also be tailored to your operations. Forwood Safety+ provides an improved risk verification experience with configurable checklist content and new features including multi-risk verification. Enhanced offline capabilities reduce load times when connectivity is limited or unavailable.



Key Features:

Patented three-tiered Critical Control Verification Checklists

Simple, streamlined setup

Easy-to-use mobile interface for online or offline risk verifications

Tailor to your operations with configurable content including images, questions, answer types and tool tips

Action Plan management to ensure controls not in place are captured

Geospatial tools for geolocation of risk verifications



What’s new in Forwood Safety+:

Multi-risk and control verification feature

Improved risk verification experience

Enhanced flexibility

Improved offline capabilities

Improved stability and enhanced load times



About Us
Forwood Safety is the global leader in fatality prevention. Our cutting-edge Critical Risk Management platform CRM+ is used at over 800+ sites in 60 countries and by prominent companies in mining, construction, telecommunications and more. All our customers have achieved zero fatalities after fully implementing and maintaining CRM+. With over 15 years in the risk management industry, Forwood Safety is led by an expert team of safety professionals to deliver proven, experience-based risk solutions.



Please reach out to Forwood using our website to register your interest at www.forwoodsafety.com

- We are pleased to announce the release of Safety+ Mobile App 1.2.0, which introduces enhanced data capture capabilities for field users. With flows aligned to the existing web application, users can now create safety records in real time, both online and offline, with automatic synchronization once connectivity is restored.

These improvements ensure consistency across platforms and empower field teams to document safety activities seamlessly, maintaining data accuracy and continuity in all working conditions.

Modules introduced in this release:

Report Incidents – Log incident records instantly.


General Inspections – Conduct inspections on-site with ease.

Safety Meetings – Capture meeting details and associated action plans.

Safety Conversations – Capture safety conversation details and associated action plans.

Risk Verifications – Verify risk assessments directly from the app.
